prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: production photographic background for the services section of an institutional Company Secretary firm in Mumbai.
Create ONE standalone photograph, landscape 16:9, ideally 2560x1440 or larger. It will fill an entire website section edge to edge, not sit inside a card.
Art direction: contemporary corporate documentary photography with Swiss compositional discipline. Elegant, credible, tactile and noticeably COLOURFUL. Natural rich blue, forest green, teal and warm materials; neutral paper. Luminous daylight, subtle warm highlights, real photographic detail and texture. Balanced contrast with good shadow detail. No grayscale, monochrome, sepia, aggressive desaturation, orange-and-teal film grade or black crushed shadows.
Composition: a deliberately quiet leftmost 35-40 percent of the frame for a later website navigation/text overlay, naturally provided by a real surface or shadowed part of the scene; no empty artificial panel and no baked-in gradients. The recognisable subject occupies the centre-right, with breathing room around its edges and a clear focal point around 65-70 percent of frame width. Preserve a useful central/right portrait crop for mobile. The scene should remain visually interesting at full-section scale.
No people, hands, handshakes, logos, watermarks, graphic overlays, decorative charts, icons or website interface. No large readable legal text, invented official seals, fake approval stamps or certificates. Paper text should be small, incidental and naturally out of focus.

Input image: composition and subject reference ONLY, the existing boardroom photograph. Preserve the formal boardroom character and compelling perspective but produce a fresh, colourful, naturally lit photograph. Recompose for a section-wide background with the main perspective centre-right.
Subject: an elegant contemporary Mumbai boardroom, expansive deep-walnut conference table and tailored muted forest-green chairs, fine real wood grain and fabric. Floor-to-ceiling windows on the centre-right reveal a believable softly focused Mumbai business district, without pretending to be the firm's actual office. Clear blue daylight and gentle warm afternoon sun; a restrained indoor plant near the far right. View from a rear-left position, the table's vanishing point around two-thirds across the frame. The left third is a naturally quieter shaded slate-blue interior wall with a little warm timber detailing. No artificial blank panel. Rich blue glazing, green upholstery, walnut and soft warm stone make the scene distinctly colour photography. No people, staged handshake, enormous chandelier, luxury-hotel excess or washed-out fog.
